scoring_justification: T1 recompute infeasible (raw stress-strain data not submitted); T2 consistency infeasible (no per-step predictions); T3 structural: verify monotonic trend of critical stress/strain with separation distance, check threshold distance matches paper, and validate property values against paper-derived references using generous tolerances that accommodate independent MD re-run variability.

hidden_assets.purpose: reference values for mechanical properties derived from paper's fitted equations and reported numbers
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper (Solid State Communications 2011), Table 2, text, Eqs.1-2, and text for triple vacancy verification
hidden_assets.generation_method: Combination of paper-reported values (perfect SLGS: Y=0.7985 TPa, sigma_cr=115.72 GPa, epsilon_cr=20.2%; SV: sigma_cr=108.8 GPa, epsilon_cr=18.41%) and fitted formulas (Eqs.1-2 with K=0.553, n=1.13 for strain; K'=0.308, n'=1.4 for stress) to generate expected values for double vacancy samples; Young's moduli for defective sheets approximated from reported range. Threshold distance 46.86 Angstrom from paper.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These values are directly traceable to the paper's reported data and fitted equations, extracted to define the expected reproduction target.

outputs.description: Mechanical properties computed for each graphene configuration and the threshold separation distance where double vacancies behave like a single vacancy.

steps.description: Validate all sample properties and threshold distance
